summary.intent: Fix a release gate misconfiguration where non-release PRs (e.g. test: commits) were auto-passing the 'Verify E2E Passed' required check without actually waiting for E2E tests to complete.
summary.outcome: Updated release-gate.yml to add a `run-web-e2e` job via workflow_call for non-release PRs that touch relevant paths, and wired `verify-e2e` to gate on that result instead of auto-passing.

repo: release-gate.yml only enforced E2E checks for release-please--* branches; all other PRs got 'Not a release PR — E2E gate not applicable' and passed green
e2e.yml only triggers on push to main, not on PRs — so E2E runs post-merge, not pre-merge for feature PRs
The 'Verify E2E Passed' check was a required GitHub branch protection check but was effectively a no-op for non-release PRs
vars context is automatically inherited in reusable workflows called via workflow_call, no special handling needed

code.finding: Auto-pass logic for non-release PRs: 'Not a release PR — E2E gate not applicable' — this was the root cause of the gate bypass
Only has push trigger on main branch; lacks pull_request trigger, so E2E never runs during PR review

workflow: A required GitHub check that unconditionally passes for certain PR types provides false security — the gate must actually block or run real verification
Polling for CI results using background tasks with wait-then-check patterns creates many short-lived tasks; better to use a single longer poll or webhook-style notification
When a PR has a test: conventional commit prefix, reviewers should verify the release gate actually ran E2E — it may have auto-passed

friction: The release gate silently auto-passed for non-release PRs, so the merge happened before E2E results were available — only discovered post-merge
Finding the correct REST comment IDs for CodeRabbit review threads required multiple gh API calls
Background polling tasks proliferated (15+ tasks) due to incremental retry intervals — difficult to track which polls were still relevant
open_items: The e2e.yml workflow still lacks a pull_request trigger with path filters — E2E only runs post-merge to main, not during PR review for feature branches
